title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam recognizing Earth as the nurturing mother of all life
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam recognizing Earth as the nurturing mother of all life प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                06 AUG 2026 11:07AM by PIB Delhi The Prime Minister,  Shri Narendra Modi today shared Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasising that humanity may live in harmony with the Earth, as earth is the nurturing mother of all life and the moral order that sustains her should be respected. The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit verse- विश्वस्वं मातरमोषधीनां ध्रुवां भूमिं पृथिवीं धर्मणा धृताम्। शिवां स्योनामनु चरेम विश्वहा॥ The Prime Minister posted on X: विश्वस्वं मातरमोषधीनां ध्रुवां भूमिं पृथिवीं धर्मणा धृताम्। शिवां स्योनामनु चरेम विश्वहा॥ विश्वस्वं मातरमोषधीनां ध्रुवां भूमिं पृथिवीं धर्मणा धृताम्। शिवां स्योनामनु चरेम विश्वहा॥ pic.twitter.com/jjaeiNMgvJ — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 6, 2026 *** MJPS/SS/VJ (रिलीज़ आईडी: 2295316) आगंतुक पटल  : 6 Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam recognizing Earth as the nurturing mother of all life प्रविष्टि तिथि:
